newsitem.title: UK: SocGen launches $30mln Romania equity fund.
newsitem.headline: SocGen launches $30mln Romania equity fund.

text.p: Societe Generale's Emerging Europe Asset Management (SGEEAM) said on Thursday it had set up a $30 million Romanian fund investing in a balanced portfolio of Romanian-based equities.
The Societe Generale Romania Fund, with an issue size of $30 million, had a $50 million maximum and $100,000 minimum investment. The closing subscription date is March 20.
"As central Europe's second largest market, Romania is attracting a great deal of international attention from investors," it said in a statement.
The fund, which will invest in listed and unlisted securities, will be a closed-end investment company incorporated in Guernsey.
It said the new government had committed itself to a comprehensive package of social and economic reforms.

"The change in political will and the potential growth have convinced SGEEAM to establish this new fund to provide investors with the opportunity to participate in dynamic companies at an early stage of development," SocGen said.
A local asset management office has been set up.
